content.thinking: הכתבה על קרן ההשתלמות מסבירה שהחיסכון נמשך בפטור ממס לאחר שש שנים, והמעסיק מפקיד 7.5% מהשכר לעומת 2.5% מכם. אני מדלג על הסכום של 15,712 ₪ ואבדוק עכשיו את התנאים לשכר שלי.

The narration is in English and Hebrew mixed, but its own sentences are English, so the rewrite is English. It reads as Claude's own process notes on a savings calculator page, so I'll describe what Claude found and what it skipped.

The savings calculator shows 18,000 ₪ deposited against 54,000 ₪ added by the employer, with 13,974 ₪ tax at 5 years and 66,513 ₪ left after tax. Claude is skipping the no-tax slider and the grey fine-print lines and moving on.
כרגע אני בודק את תנאי הקרן: הכסף פנוי אחרי 6 שנים, ביצוע משיכה לוקח עד 4 ימי עסקים. דמי הניהול עד 2% בשנה, בלי דמי יציאה, ואין מס על הרווחים. הבאה: אשווה בין הראל, אלטשולר שחם, מיטב והפניקס.
משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית אבל תהיה יקרה, ולכן אני לא נוגע בכלום לפני השעה 6. לא קראתי את שאר הסעיפים, כולל הסיכונים וה"מונחים".

input.answer: Yeah, it's worth having: my boss puts in 7.5% of my salary and I put in 2.5%, and after 6 years I can take it all out tax-free. Their example has me putting in 18,000 and walking out with about 66,000 even after paying tax at 5 years, so I'm keeping it and not touching it before 6.

stuck.why: It was set to 5 years, with a red −13,974 ₪ tax. I wanted to see 6 years with no tax, but I'm not dragging a marker on my phone, so I never saw the tax-free number.
I only know my take-home (9,500), not my gross, so I left it at 12,000. The numbers aren't really mine.

stuck.where: 'משיכה סוגרת את החשבון להפקדות נוספות' in סיכונים
stuck.why: I wasn't sure whether taking money out after 6 years closes the whole fund for me. I didn't read on.

findings.what: The calculator defaults to 5 years, so the first thing you see is a red minus-13,974 tax. It makes the product look scary even though at 6 years there's no tax.
Changing the year means dragging a small marker, which is annoying on a phone
It asks for gross salary, but I only know my take-home
The fee is only given as a percent ('עד 2%'), never in shekels, so I can't tell if it matters
Lots of small grey notes and 'חוקים וכללים' badges everywhere, so it looks like a legal document
The orange warning mixes in 31% and 47% with no clear shekel figure
No clear 'what to do now' step
findings.where: End of the sections I read
